issue: When a district court must choose the most analogous Guideline among several sufficiently analogous Guidelines under the Guidelines' analogous-offense analysis, should the appellate court review that choice de novo or give it deference?

sides.position: Review the district court's choice of the most analogous guideline de novo.
Give the district court's choice of the most analogous guideline due deference.

quote: Appellate courts differ on whether the district court's decision at this step should be reviewed de novo or given due deference.
cite: United States v. Shamar Betts, No. 21-3157 (7th Cir. 2024)
